name: SolidCraft
title: SolidCraft: free Autodesk Fusion alternative
hook: Autodesk Fusion charges you six hundred eighty dollars a year to design 3D parts. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Sketch it. Then make it solid.
features.say: Draw a shape, lock it in with dimensions and constraints, then extrude it.
Every step lands on a timeline. Change a dimension and the whole model rebuilds.

install_line: It runs on Mac, Windows and Linux, or right in your browser. Just grab the free download.
caption:
Autodesk Fusion charges $680/year. SolidCraft designs your 3D parts for free 🛠️

✅ Sketch with dimensions and constraints
✅ Extrude, revolve, fillet, shell and more on an editable timeline
✅ Change a dimension and the model rebuilds
✅ Opens and saves STEP, STL and 3MF files

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · or try it in your browser
ℹ️ It's early (version 0.x): great for simple parts, but not a full Fusion replacement yet. Fusion also has a free limited personal-use plan, and the downloads aren't signed yet so your first launch needs "Open anyway".

Comment "MODEL" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
